    /**
     * Get delegation message by scenario and language code.
     */
    public static function getMessage(string $scenario, string $lang): string
    {
        $constName = 'DELEGATION_' . strtoupper($scenario) . '_' . strtoupper(str_replace('-', '', $lang));
        return defined("static::{$constName}") ? constant("static::{$constName}") : '';
    }
